categories.label: Injuries & availability
categories.summary: Starting-QB identity, official game status and replacement uncertainty are tracked separately from the frozen numerical projection.

items.title: Hard-QB breaks
items.detail: Confirmed starter changes are treated as reliability and release-state events. The current operational QB point adjustment remains zero because an additive coefficient has not been prospectively validated.

items.title: Final inactives
items.detail: Official inactive lists are checked close to kickoff and can change contextual reliability without rewriting the frozen canonical projection.

items.title: Personnel discipline
items.detail: Non-QB absences are recorded as context unless a historically validated adjustment exists.

categories.label: Weather & venue
categories.summary: Wind, precipitation, temperature and roof state are timestamped and surfaced as context rather than converted into arbitrary points.

items.title: Forecast timing
items.detail: Outdoor forecasts are refreshed close to kickoff because early-week weather can change materially.

items.title: Roof status
items.detail: Retractable-roof decisions stay explicitly pending until an official or reliable venue update resolves them.

items.title: Model treatment
items.detail: Weather can elevate uncertainty or HOLD status; it does not receive a discretionary numerical adjustment.

categories.label: Market comparison
categories.summary: The NFL projection is independent of sportsbook lines. Public prices are comparison benchmarks unless account-level execution is verified.

items.title: Current benchmark
items.detail: The current Week 6 board uses a timestamped BetMGM public benchmark captured before publication.

items.title: Model / market difference
items.detail: A numerical difference is descriptive research only. Historical testing did not support a simple larger-difference-equals-better-edge rule.

items.title: CLV / ROI
items.detail: CLV and ROI are not reported without timestamped executable entry prices and a consistent closing-price definition.

categories.label: Efficiency & architecture
categories.summary: The spread model uses only feature families that survived leakage-safe out-of-sample testing; the totals model remains deliberately simpler.

items.title: Canonical spread
items.detail: Frozen core efficiency plus validated defensive coverage, market-independent recursive win Elo and margin rating.

items.title: Canonical total
items.detail: Frozen core totals architecture. Pace, red-zone and other tested additions did not earn robust promotion.

items.title: FTN50
items.detail: FTN50 remains a shadow/challenger model and cannot silently replace the canonical projection without explicit promotion review.

categories.label: Validation
categories.summary: Historical research validation is complete, but betting recommendation thresholds remain locked while prospective frozen-week evidence accumulates.

items.title: Historical sample
items.detail: The canonical architecture has 816 outer out-of-sample games from 2023-2025.

items.title: Win probability
items.detail: Canonical-margin win probability passed the separate walk-forward research-display calibration gate. Moneyline edge remains HOLD.

items.title: Prospective milestones
items.detail: Research/Beta review begins at 40+ completed prospective games across at least 3 frozen weeks; recommendation calibration review begins at 75+ games across at least 5 weeks and still requires explicit review.

categories.label: Weekly production workflow
categories.summary: Each week uses an immutable prediction freeze followed by separate context, market, grading and registry updates.

items.title: Pregame freeze
items.detail: Canonical and challenger projections are timestamped before games and are never rewritten after results are known.

items.title: Game-day gates
items.detail: Starting QB, final inactives, weather/roof and fresh public market benchmarks are refreshed separately from the frozen numerical prediction.

items.title: Postgame grading
items.detail: Canonical and FTN50 are graded on identical games, then the prospective registry updates model-health and release-calibration evidence.
